name: Passive Capture / Handshake Collection
description: Passive wireless capture involves monitoring 802.11 traffic without transmitting, collecting WPA2/WPA3 handshakes for offline cracking. The Pwnagotchi automates this as a standalone device — it moves through an area, captures handshakes, and logs them for later processing. This technique generates no transmission and is essentially invisible to wireless intrusion detection systems.

blue.det: WIDS may detect passive scanning; WPA3 networks prevent handshake capture entirely; unusual probe requests near perimeter.
blue.cm: Upgrade to WPA3 — handshakes not capturable; WIDS deployment; minimize signal leakage outside building; 802.1X for enterprise networks.
